Grants an extra <void/>Smoke Bomb Melee Ability Charge.

<void/>Invisibility now grants <pve 50% /> <pvp [10%] /> Damage Resistance (Resist x4).

<void/>Cloaking allies starts their health regeneration, grants them the same Damage Resist benefits, and refunds 50% Melee Ability Energy per ally made invisible.

Damage Resistance does not apply while in Super.
